# Tier `maxwell-3`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 32768 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `f16` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-e2b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 32768 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | dropped | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gemma4-e2b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo-q8_0.bin` | swappable |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

The installer seeds this tier's media bindings (`config_seed`):

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `animategen_script` | `` |
| `compose_script` | `render/compose-hyperframes.mjs` |
| `imagegen_engine` | `sdcpp` |
| `imagegen_timeout_sec` | `900` |
| `musicgen_script` | `` |
| `run_graph_script` | `` |
| `sdcpp_bin` | `__OFFLOAD_HOME__/sdcpp/sd-cli__EXE__` |
| `vae_mode` | `tiling` |
| `videogen_script` | `` |
| `voicegen_script` | `` |

`__OFFLOAD_HOME__` is replaced with the install root at render time.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media
seed, but they bind no media route — the agent/cascade seats and per-node knobs live
here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `agent_profile` | `research` |
| `escalation_model` | `` |
| `fleet_max_concurrent_jobs` | `1` |
| `model` | `gemma4-e2b` |
| `reasoning_model` | `` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #18: the 3 GB band (sm_52 Maxwell, GTX 970M-class). Reference box <node-g>, the 2015 gaming laptop: GTX 970M 3 GB GDDR5, a 4-core/8-thread Skylake mobile CPU, 32 GB DDR4. Spec: docs/specs/2026-10-28-maxwell-3-tier-design.md. Every value below is MEASURED on that box on 2026-10-28 (fit smokes, media smokes, the agent bake and its judge); nothing in this entry is a projection. ENGINE (MEASURED 2026-10-28): the llama.cpp b11490 win-cuda-12.4 prebuilt (the build measured) runs on sm_52 through its embedded sm_50 PTX - a one-time JIT of ~36 s cached under CUDA_CACHE_PATH (the install sets CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE so the cache is never evicted); CUDA graphs are disabled below Volta by the backend itself (disable_cuda_graphs true is documentary), there is no fp16 math and no MMQ, so prefill is dequant-to-F32 + cuBLAS, and flash-attn runs through the f32 vec/tile kernels - MEASURED FASTER on this card, so it stays on. E2B UD-Q4_K_XL llama-bench: pp512 374 t/s, tg128 39.2 t/s (43.1 t/s with flash-attn on); llama-server fits 8K/16K/32K with q8_0 KV at 1434/1468/1535 MiB and 16K f16 flash-attn-on at 1517 MiB (40.7 t/s); 1037 MHz, 56-60 C, 22-28 W. RESIDENT TIER E2B, E4B OMITTED (omit_e4b): the E4B needs 3,100 MiB at 16K (measured on <node-c>), more than the 3,072 MiB card holds beside the resident embedder and the WDDM reserve, so the workhorse here is the E2B, config_seed.model names it, and the 6 GB band's E4B entry and download are dropped rather than rendered into an OOM. CTX 32K, f16 KV: the Gemma-4 E-series KV barely grows (512-token sliding window), f16 costs tens of MiB over q8_0 at 32K, and q8_0's dequant has no fp16 path on this card. 26B DROPPED: no placement fits a 3 GB card. AGENT SEAT (MEASURED 2026-10-28, the bake on <node-g>): the resident E2B is the agent seat (config_seed.model; no separate agent_model entry), chosen by the house bake instrument over five fitting candidates and the spill arm: G1 fit (>= 200 MiB free at peak, >= 10 tok/s decode), G2 ten strict tool calls, G3 the grounded digest-8 contract through `local-offload delegate` (bar 8/8 succeeded, 0 failed_verification), G4 a typed judge (a paid decision-model API) over the survivors. gemma4-e2b: G1 30.1 tok/s decode / 169 prefill, 2,092 MiB peak (926 free), G2 10/10, G3 8/8 in 383 s, every digest format-clean. LFM3-1.7B Q8_0 (b11946): 31.7 / 397, 2,744 peak (274 free), 10/10, 8/8 in 400 s, 5/8 format-clean. LFM3-1.7B Q6_K (b11946): 29.0 / 405, 2,345 peak (674 free), 10/10, 8/8 in 456 s, 7/8 format-clean. Qwen3.5-2B UD-Q4_K_XL: 25.3 / 370, 2,248 peak, 10/10, G3 6/8 with 2 ungrounded (out). LFM3-1.7B QAD-Q4_0: 35.7 / 378, 1,984 peak, 10/10, G3 7/8 with 1 ungrounded (out). Qwen3.5-4B (UD-IQ3_XXS and UD-Q4_K_XL) and MiniCPM5-2B Q4_K_M failed G1 in the fit smoke (65-87 MiB free at 32K; the IQ3 path decodes at 6 tok/s on sm_52). G4 over the three survivors (eight digests each, mean): fabrication signal E2B 0.25, Q6_K 0.31, Q8_0 0.34 (lower is more faithful; a read of the digests agrees: one misattributed cause in E2B's eight, two inverted conditions in Q6_K's, three misreadings in Q8_0's); coverage Q6_K 2.96, E2B 2.83, Q8_0 2.80 of 3; specificity 1.96-1.97 of 2 for all three. E2B wins on fidelity, format, headroom (252-652 MiB more free at peak than the LFM3 arms), the engine every node already runs (LFM3 needs b11938 or later) and shared weights (chat, agent and vision are one file, so an agent call never evicts the chat seat). LFM3-1.7B Q6_K is the measured runner-up on coverage and becomes an opt-in agent entry once the newest complete build carries it (b11938 or later; the installer already takes the newest build); its 2.4x prefill did not shorten G3 because it writes longer digests. Like every tier, the delegator side (agent_delegate and `local-offload delegate`) is the operator's opt-in, config key agent_delegation_enabled (no tier seeds it); with it on, one grounded digest contract ran through the installed stack on 11436 (MEASURED 2026-10-28: `local-offload delegate -route local`, succeeded 1, failed_verification 0, 32 s wall including the seat load, three findings all in the source). MEDIA SEATS (MEASURED 2026-10-28, one real call each on the card, details in each seat's `measured`): vision gemma4-e2b-vision = the resident E2B weights + the ggml-org Q8_0 projector at ctx 8192 with reasoning off, 2,197 MiB loaded / 2,438 MiB peak as a seat (2,578 / 2,819 on the card with the 381 MiB embedder), a website screenshot described and a receipt extracted correctly in Spanish; stt whisper-stt = large-v3-turbo q8_0 + silero v5.1.2 with flash attention OFF (-nfa, the house Spanish-audio rule), 1,263 / 1,323 MiB measured alone, a 759 KB Spanish clip in 3.2 s with the server warm; q5_0 and flash attention on give the same transcript 0.3-0.4 s faster and 150-440 MiB lighter, so q8_0 is the quality pick, not the fast one. Through the installed stack a transcription is 7-8 s per 20 s clip, because the harness unloads the whisper seat after every call and the next call pays the load (27 s when the model file has left the page cache, 44 s once per CUDA cache directory while the PTX compiles). Both are SWAPPABLE: the embedder, the 2,009 MiB chat seat and either media seat together overflow the card, so a media call evicts the chat seat and the next chat call reloads it in ~3 s. Their weights are not downloaded by install.ps1 (model-e2b-mmproj, model-whisper-turbo-q8, model-silero-v5): placed by the operator, warned about by `install render` when absent. whisper-server itself comes from the update verb: set update.paths.whisper to the seat's directory (<home>/build/whisper.cpp/build/bin) and run `local-offload update --component whisper`, which installs the newest cuda-12 build there and keeps it current (b5454 on 2026-10-28; the card runs it through the sm_50 PTX). IMAGE (the seed binds no model: sdxl-turbo is excluded from the installer on license grounds (non-commercial) and the Z-Image set does not fit 3 GB, so an operator binds a checkpoint they are licensed to run; MEASURED 2026-10-28 with sdxl-turbo placed by hand): the sd.cpp Vulkan build measured (master-95ff762, the newest complete release the installer takes) with sdxl-turbo Q4_0 renders a correct 512x512 in 45 s on this card (4 steps, cfg 1, euler, vae tiling): sd.cpp keeps the 3.6 GB of weights in host RAM and stages them to the card per step (its auto budget on a 3 GB card; 1,964 MiB peak on the card, the RAM released when the job exits), which is the spill shape the house allows for sd.cpp. The lane picks the discrete adapter itself (the Intel iGPU on this laptop renders the same image 3.5x slower). config_seed binds it exactly as ampere-6 does; the binary and the weights are placed by the operator, since the installer media leg is the amd-rdna3 set. RAM SPILL (ADR 0080, MEASURED 2026-10-28): Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-IQ3_XXS (12.6 GB) on b11946 with --n-cpu-moe 40 at ctx 16384 q8_0 KV loads in 10 s (2,158-2,613 MiB on the card, 11.4 GB host RSS, MemAvailable 24.6 -> 13.3 GB and back after exit, no paging): gate 2 (no RAM hog) and gate 3 (stable) hold, gate 1 (adds capability) FAILS on this host: decode 9.4-10.9 tok/s and prefill 60-72 tok/s (llama-bench tg 8.9-11.0 at 4-8 threads), under the G1 bar and about 4x slower than the 2B-class seats on a digest, because this laptop's two DIMMs sit in one channel (single-channel DDR4 bounds the expert streaming; ampere-6 measured 16.5 tok/s dual-channel). Its tool calls were 10/10. NOT carried (include_qwen36_35b stays false); re-measure if the box goes dual-channel. fleet_max_concurrent_jobs stays 1 (one slot). NOT a Blackwell-style CUDA-13 box: the cuda-13 prebuilts carry no Maxwell code, so Select-CudaBuild keeps the 12.4 prebuilt for this profile.
